summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson, a right-handed male with mixed Hodgkin's and non-Hodgkin's lymphoma involving the central nervous system, was admitted for his second maintenance cycle of high-dose methotrexate. He tolerated the chemotherapy well, with close monitoring for renal and hepatic toxicity. His leucovorin was started at 12 hours post-infusion due to prior liver enzyme elevations. Mild transaminitis occurred but resolved by discharge. A brain MRI showed no progression of disease. He received rituximab but developed rigors during infusion, consistent with a mild allergic reaction, and was treated with solumedrol and a prednisone taper. He was discharged home in stable condition with instructions to complete the steroid taper, continue bowel regimen, and follow up for ocular evaluation and lab monitoring.
problems: Hodgkin's disease, unspecified type, lymph nodes of multiple sites
